name: Boku-tachi no Asobikata
original_name: ぼくたちのあそびかた
source:
Naughty Shun and a straight-A student Itsuki are friends.
They do anything that would be fun together. 
One day, a DVD made them to do a bad thing....It escalates gradually, and then..... A simple, relaxed story.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE015814.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
淘气的瞬和成绩优异的树是朋友。
他们一起做任何有趣的事。
一天，一张DVD让他们做了一件坏事……事态逐渐升级，然后……这是一个简单轻松的故事。

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE015814.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
